contexts.text: Conjugial love is the seminary of human society. AC 2039.
Marriages are the seminaries of the human race, and thence are the seminaries of the Heavenly Kingdom. AC 5053. AC 9961:4. HH 384. AE 988:5. AE 1002:3.
For the human race is the seminary of Heaven. AC 7069. AC 9441:end. LJ 10, Explained. DWis 8. 7. DWis 12. 5. 3.
Therefore (in the ultimate) is the seminary of Heaven.
The propagation of the human race is the primary seminary of earthly and heavenly societies.
These had been preserved there... as a seminary.
The middle Heaven, where are those who are in truths from the Word, thus where is a seminary...
